decisions.reason: The building digital twin service fits the announced direction of integrating geospatial IT with enterprise systems, and its weak visibility can still be blamed on a market that is still forming, so management stays committed.
The authentication and delegation service sits close to the core offer and supports the identity ecosystem the firm has invested in, so dropping it would undercut earlier decisions.
The open GIS framework is a multi-model line with heavy sunk development and is central to the firm's open, extensible strategy, so commitment remains very high.
The identity service was publicly launched as enabling seamless GeoIT integration, and this visible commitment and its strategic fit strongly favor keeping it.
The consulting workshop was just launched with a page of its own, builds on established know-how, needs little investment and is too new to judge, so management keeps it.
